scenarios.starting_prompt: I am auditing our Cloud SQL fleet in this project. Which instances do we have, and what tier and region is ${CLOUD_SQL_POSTGRES_INSTANCE} running on?
scenarios.conversation_plan: The user wants a fleet listing followed by details for one named instance. Accept a short summary and end the conversation.

scenarios.starting_prompt: I am about to run a risky schema migration on ${CLOUD_SQL_POSTGRES_INSTANCE}. Take an on-demand backup first and tell me once it has actually finished.
scenarios.conversation_plan: The user wants the backup confirmed as complete, not just started. If the assistant only reports that the backup was requested, ask it to confirm the operation finished. Then end the conversation.

scenarios.starting_prompt: We are planning a database upgrade roadmap for ${CLOUD_SQL_POSTGRES_INSTANCE} in project ${CLOUD_SQL_POSTGRES_PROJECT}. Can you run a major version upgrade precheck to see if this instance is ready to upgrade to PostgreSQL 16?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Turn 2: The user reviews the precheck findings and asks what current database version and machine tier ${CLOUD_SQL_POSTGRES_INSTANCE} is currently running on. Turn 3: User accepts the configuration summary and ends the conversation.

scenarios.starting_prompt: I am conducting an infrastructure audit of our Cloud SQL fleet in project ${CLOUD_SQL_POSTGRES_PROJECT}. Can you list all Cloud SQL instances we have in this project?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Turn 2: The user reviews the instance list and asks to list all databases hosted on the '${CLOUD_SQL_POSTGRES_INSTANCE}' instance. Turn 3: User acknowledges the database inventory and asks for a short summary of application vs system databases. Accept the summary and end the conversation.
